title: Operators [Compound & Increment]
description:
## Compound Assignment
- `x += 5`, `x -= 5`, `x *= 5`, `x /= 5`, `x %= 5`

## Increment & Decrement
- `x++` adds 1
- `x--` subtracts 1

```qc
int count = 10;
count += 5;   // 15
count *= 2;   // 30
count++;      // 31
count--;      // 30
```

---
## Assignment:
TechQ tracks active qubits. Starting with 8 qubits:
1. Add 4 using `+=`
2. Double using `*=`
3. Subtract 6 using `-=`
4. Increment with `++`
5. Increment with `++`
